name: Mohawk Mark

skins.name: Napkin
skins.lore: The Napkin skin represents Hoodvincible, one of the most recognizable evil Invincible variants from the Invincible War. He is remembered for his hooded appearance and ruthless personality.

skins.name: Lensless
skins.lore: The Lensless skin represents Nogogglecible, an alternate Invincible variant recognizable for fighting without the goggles normally attached to the Invincible mask.

skins.name: Viltrumite
skins.lore: The Viltrumite skin represents Viltumincible, an alternate Mark Grayson fully loyal to the Viltrum Empire who embraced conquest and destruction instead of becoming Earth's hero.

skins.name: Prisoner
skins.lore: The Prisoner skin represents Prisonincible, an Invincible variant shown restrained and imprisoned following the destruction caused during the Invincible War.

skins.name: Sinister
skins.lore: The Sinister skin represents Sinister Mark, one of the most dangerous and violent Invincible variants. Unlike many others, he survived the Invincible War and later became a recurring threat in the comics.

skins.name: Fully Masked
skins.lore: The Fully Masked skin represents Maskvincible, an alternate Invincible variant known for fully covering his face and for his emotional attachment to his mother compared to the other brutal variants.

skins.name: Omni-Mark
skins.lore: The Omni-Mark skin represents an alternate Mark Grayson who followed Omni-Man completely, wearing a suit inspired by his father's design and embracing the Viltrumite mission of planetary conquest.

skins.name: Bug Eyed
skins.lore: The Bug Eyed skin represents Bug Eyed Mark, also called Goggles Mark, an alternate Invincible variant recognized for his oversized goggles and insect-like appearance.

lore: The Invincible variants are alternate versions of Mark Grayson from the Invincible comic and animated series. Across different universes and timelines, these variants developed unique appearances and personalities while sharing the same Viltrumite heritage, super strength, flight, and brutal fighting abilities.
